AKOSettings.description: This section outlines the generic AKO settings

apiServerPort.description: Internal port for AKO API server for the liveness probe of the AKO pod

blockedNamespaceList.description: List of system namespaces from which AKO will not listen any Kubernetes or Openshift object event

clusterName.description: A unique identifier for the kubernetes cluster, that helps distinguish the objects for this cluster in the avi controller.

cniPlugin.description: Set the string if your CNI is calico or openshift or ovn-kubernetes. For Cilium CNI, set the string as cilium only when using Cluster Scope mode for IPAM and leave it empty if using Kubernetes Host Scope mode for IPAM.

deleteConfig.description: Has to be set to true in configmap if user wants to delete AKO created objects from AVI

disableStaticRouteSync.description: If the POD networks are reachable from the Avi SE, set this knob to true.

enableEVH.description: This enables the Enhanced Virtual Hosting Model in Avi Controller for the Virtual Services

enableExternalNameService.description: Enables processing of Service type ExternalName

fullSyncFrequency.description: Interval (in seconds) at which AKO refreshes its internal cache of Avi cloud properties and resets retry counters. Note: This does not restore Avi objects deleted out-of-band.

ipFamily.description: This flag can take values V4 or V6 (default V4). This is for the backend pools to use ipv6 or ipv4.

istioEnabled.description: This flag needs to be enabled when AKO is be to brought up in an Istio environment

layer7Only.description: If this flag is switched on, then AKO will only do layer 7 loadbalancing.

namespaceSelector.description: NamespaceSelector contains label key and value used for namespace migration/sync to AKO

primaryInstance.description: Defines AKO instance is primary or not. Value `true` indicates that AKO instance is primary. In a multiple AKO deployment in a cluster, only one AKO instance should be primary.

servicesAPI.description: Flag that enables AKO in services API mode

useDefaultSecretsOnly.description: If this flag is set to true, AKO will only handle default secrets from the namespace where AKO is installed. This flag is applicable only to Openshift clusters.

vipPerNamespace.description: Enabling this flag would tell AKO to create Parent VS per Namespace in EVH mode

vpcMode.description: VPCMode enables AKO to operate in VPC mode. This flag is only applicable to NSX-T.

ControllerSettings.description: This section outlines settings on the Avi controller that affects AKO functionality.

cloudName.description: The configured cloud name on the Avi controller.

controllerHost.description: IP address or Hostname of Avi Controller

dedicatedTenantMode.description: If true, AKO cache will be scoped to its specific tenant instead of querying all tenants.

tenantName.description: Name of the tenant where all the AKO objects will be created in AVI.

vrfName.description: Name of the VRFContext. All Avi objects will be under this VRF. Applicable only in Vcenter Cloud.

L4Settings.description: This section outlines all the knobs used to control Layer 4 loadbalancing settings in AKO.

autoFQDN.description: FQDN generation control. Options: default(<svc>.<ns>.<subdomain>), flat (<svc>-<ns>.<subdomain>), "disabled"

defaultDomain.description: If multiple sub-domains are configured in the cloud, use this knob to set the default sub-domain to use for L4 VSes

defaultLBController.description: Enable/disable AKO as the default load balancer controller

L7Settings.description: This section outlines all the knobs used to control Layer 7 loadbalancing settings in AKO.

defaultIngController.description: Enable/disable AKO as the default ingress controller

fqdnReusePolicy.description: Use this to control whether AKO allows cross-namespace usage of FQDNs

noPGForSNI.description: Switching this knob to true, will get rid of poolgroups from SNI VSes. Do not use this flag, if you do not want http caching.

passthroughShardSize.description: Control the passthrough virtualservice numbers using this ENUM

serviceType.description: Type of service for layer 7 virtualservices

shardVSSize.description: Use this to control the layer 7 VS numbers. This applies to both secure/insecure VSes but does not apply for passthrough.

NetworkSettings.description: This section outlines the network settings for virtualservices

bgpPeerLabels.description: Select BGP peers using bgpPeerLabels, for selective VsVip advertisement

defaultDomain.description: The defaultDomain flag can be used to set the default sub-domain to use for the VS

enableAutogw.description: If true, the controller sends response traffic back to the source MAC address of the connection rather than to a default gateway. This is a cluster wide setting for all Virtual Services

enableRHI.description: This is a cluster wide setting for BGP peering

nodeNetworkList.description: List of network and cidrs used in pool placement network for vcenter cloud

nsxtT1LR.description: Unique ID (note: not display name) of the T1 Logical Router for Service Engine connectivity. Only applies to NSX-T cloud

vipNetworkList.description: Network information of the VIP network. Multiple networks allowed only for AWS Cloud

akoCRDOperatorLogFile.description: Name of the AKO CRD Operator log file

akoGatewayLogFile.description: Name of the AKO Gateway log file

avicredentials.description: Avi Controller credentials. If username and either password or authtoken are not specified, avi-secret will not be created.

authtoken.description: Auth token for Avi Controller authentication (alternative to password)

certificateAuthorityData.description: Certificate authority data for Avi Controller TLS verification

crdOperatorResources.description: Resource limits and requests for AKO CRD Operator container (separate from main AKO, uses smaller resources by default)

limits.description: Resource limits for CRD Operator container

cpu.description: CPU limit for CRD Operator container

memory.description: Memory limit for CRD Operator container

requests.description: Resource requests for CRD Operator container

cpu.description: CPU request for CRD Operator container

memory.description: Memory request for CRD Operator container

logFile.description: Name of the AKO log file

mountPath.description: Mount path for the persistent volume inside AKO containers

namespace.description: Namespace where AKO and related resources will be deployed

nodePortSelector.description: Node port selector for NodePort services

key.description: Node selector key for NodePort services

value.description: Node selector value for NodePort services

persistentVolumeClaim.description: Name of an existing PersistentVolumeClaim to use for both AKO and CRD Operator logs. Leave empty to auto-create separate PVCs (recommended).

persistentVolumeClaimSpec.description: PVC specification for auto-creating PersistentVolumeClaim for AKO logs. Only used if persistentVolumeClaim is empty.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the PersistentVolumeClaim

enabled.description: Enable persistent volume for AKO logs. If false, emptyDir will be used (logs lost on pod restart)

storage.description: Storage size for both PVCs. If not set, defaults to 2Gi for AKO and 1Gi for CRD Operator. If set, applies the same size to both.

storageClassName.description: StorageClass name for the PVC. If empty, auto-detected from cluster topology or cluster default StorageClass will be used

priorityClassName.description: Pod priority class for AKO and CRD Operator pods.

resources.description: Resource limits and requests for AKO main container and Gateway API container

limits.description: Resource limits for AKO main and Gateway API containers

cpu.description: CPU limit for AKO main and Gateway API containers

memory.description: Memory limit for AKO main and Gateway API containers

requests.description: Resource requests for AKO main and Gateway API containers

cpu.description: CPU request for AKO main and Gateway API containers

memory.description: Memory request for AKO main and Gateway API containers

statusStreamer.description: Status streamer configuration for operational status streaming from Avi Controller

enabled.description: Enable AKO status streamer sidecar for operational status streaming from Avi Controller.

resources.description: Resource limits and requests for status streamer sidecar container

limits.description: Resource limits for status streamer sidecar

cpu.description: CPU limit for status streamer sidecar

memory.description: Memory limit for status streamer sidecar

requests.description: Resource requests for status streamer sidecar

cpu.description: CPU request for status streamer sidecar

memory.description: Memory request for status streamer sidecar

statusStreamerLogFile.description: Name of the AKO status streamer log file

vmciRelayResources.description: Resource limits and requests for VMCI relay sidecar container (TCP proxy used in VKS managed mode)

limits.description: Resource limits for VMCI relay sidecar

cpu.description: CPU limit for VMCI relay sidecar

memory.description: Memory limit for VMCI relay sidecar

requests.description: Resource requests for VMCI relay sidecar

cpu.description: CPU request for VMCI relay sidecar

memory.description: Memory request for VMCI relay sidecar
